properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Math.random() is the only randomness source at all 8 sites: JSONP callback/cache-buster suffix (bitanalytics.js:3256), random tracking-ID and UUID-v4-style generation (6967, 7035, 7099, 7517, 7525, 868) in the bundled bitanalytics library, and random banner rotation (bannerService.js:69). components.name: hardcoded secret

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SideShift.ai exchange integration's app credential, hardcoded at build time and passed to the SideshiftApi constructor (line 300: new Sideshift.SideshiftApi(PUBLIC_API_KEY)). It is the deliberately-public identifier half of SideShift's key pair (the signing secret is separate and not present in this file); it identifies this wallet build to the exchange but is not secret key material.

components.name: SHA-256

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Stanford JS Crypto Library (sjcl) SHA-256 hashing wallet IDs (w.id) and hex-encoded, then matched against a stored walletIdHashed via lodash.isEqual to find a wallet in the local list. Real SHA-256 in use; the comparison is non-constant-time but both inputs are the app's own records, not attacker-supplied, so no timing exposure.

components.name: Node.js tls sessions on default settings (Node.js version unknown)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CORRECTION to earlier site contexts: the Node.js version IS pinned — app-template/package-template.json engines {"node": "6", "npm": "3"} (lines 44-46). Node 6 ships OpenSSL 1.0.2-era TLS: max TLS 1.2, default ECDHE key exchange, no post-quantum group available at any configuration. components.name: PKCS#12 keystore

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Windows code-signing keystore reference in Cordova build config. The PFX itself is NOT committed to the repo (grep for *.pfx finds only this config line). CordovaApp_TemporaryKey.pfx is the Visual Studio-generated temporary/test package-signing certificate, not a production store-issued key; it certifies the Windows app package build. Changeable here (swap in a real EV/production PFX and reference it).
